website.note: Corporate site describes the marketed Allurion Smart Capsule / Balloon device and references the AUDACITY pivotal IDE study (now supporting FDA approval). No drug pipeline page.

ctgov.note: ctgov hits relate to device studies (no Phase 1-3 drug studies).

marketed_devices: Allurion Balloon (Smart Capsule) — swallowable, fluid-filled intragastric balloon for weight loss; FDA-approved (PMA) following the AUDACITY pivotal IDE study; CE-marked in Europe and approved in many additional markets.
supporting_platform: Allurion Virtual Care Suite (Iris AI, Allurion App, Allurion Connected Scale) — digital companion tools.
commercial_product.regulatory_basis: Class III medical device approved via PMA (US) / CE-mark (EU). No drug-substance P1/P2/P3 program.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pure medical-device company (intragastric weight-loss balloon and digital companion tools). All clinical work is device PMA/post-market evidence, not drug-style P1/P2/P3 trials. No proprietary drug or biologic pipeline.
